description: Remind a person about an issue, a project or a comment at a time. It is delivered to the channels that person switched on (the bell in Mewboard, email, Telegram). Give exactly one target (issue, project or comment_id) and the time as `at` (ISO 8601 with time zone, e.g. 2026-10-20T09:00:00+03:00) or `in_minutes`. By default the reminder is for the owner of this token; pass `user` (a name) to remind another member of the workspace. repeat: daily, weekly or monthly (optional).

at.description: ISO 8601 time with time zone, e.g. 2026-10-20T09:00:00+03:00

in_minutes.description: remind in this many minutes from now, e.g. 30 (instead of at)

note.description: what to remind about, e.g. "Call the client back"

repeat.description: daily, weekly or monthly; omit for a one-time reminder

user.description: member name to remind (see list_members); default: you

name: create_reminder
